description: Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) - Object Locations is a dataset listed in City of Los Angeles open data portal (data.lacity.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Los Angeles. GIS locations of items located at LAWA Campus'. Currently populated with defibrillator (Monthly) Data is push daily, but not all datasets are updated daily. Coverage: Los Angeles. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are lax defibrillators airport emergency. The table has 10 columns. Attribution on the portal: Los Angeles World Airports. The portal shows 2019-05-21 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-lacity-org-portal.
